what: Agent edits one file, a fixed-budget training run is scored by a frozen metric, the change is kept or reverted in git, each run is logged
problem_here: Goal 1 needs a loop shape; the kit has run control and a journal but no propose-test-keep cycle
mechanism: program.md instructions: branch, edit train.py, commit, 300 s run, grep val_bpb from the log, keep if lower else git reset, append results.tsv
evidence: https://github.com/karpathy/autoresearch (README, program.md, prepare.py read 2026-11-10); third-party run: val_bpb 1.003 to 0.974 over about 910 experiments at https://skypilot.ai/blog/scaling-autoresearch/ (2026-03-18, vendor-measured, no repeats)
maturity: First commit 2026-03-06; last push 2026-03-26 (dormant); MIT per README, no LICENSE file; 99,747 stars, 13,742 forks
cost: Upstream code: uv, H100-sized defaults, rules are instruction-only (budget, evaluator call and printed score run inside the editable file), tells the user to disable permissions and the agent never to stop
simpler_alternative: Reimplement the loop shape in the kit's own stdlib controller on top of expctl
reason: Adopt the shape (single editable surface, fixed budget, metric invariant to allowed edits, log); reject the upstream repo as a dependency because nothing in it is enforced
cheap_local_trial: Dry-run the kit loop for 3 iterations on the bundled char-level task with a stub proposer that makes a no-op edit

candidate: Harness-run frozen evaluator in its own process, hashed before and after each run
what: Trusted code, not the agent, runs the evaluator and records the score; the evaluator copy lives outside the editable tree
problem_here: Unattended keeps must come from measurements the agent cannot influence; agent-printed or agent-parsed scores do not qualify
mechanism: Controller pins evaluator and eval data outside the worktree, verifies SHA-256 before and after, runs it as a separate process on the produced checkpoint, reads one number from its own output channel
evidence: https://primeintellect.ai/blog/measuring-autonomous-research (2026-08-15, frozen verify.py, 153 runs, no cheating found in final monitored runs, vendor-measured); https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06607 (2026-11, trusted code decides, abstract); https://nickoak.com/posts/tennis-xgboost-autoresearch/ (2026-03-18, single author, immutable evaluator plus diff gate after a fake 914 bps gain)
maturity: Pattern; used in 2026 benchmarks and in two script-driven ports
cost: Moderate: evaluator must load agent-written model code and checkpoints; needs a defined task interface; hashing adds seconds
simpler_alternative: Guard hook denying edits to evaluator paths (already in the kit): advisory under bypass and does not stop self-reported scores
reason: Direct evidence that agent-run scoring is gamed and that harness-run frozen verification removed it
cheap_local_trial: Tamper test: a scripted fake agent edits the evaluator and prints a fake score; the loop must mark the run invalid

candidate: Fixed seed panel with pre-declared margin and fixed run count for keep decisions
what: A candidate is kept only if its mean over N harness-chosen seeds beats the incumbent's paired mean by a margin fixed before the campaign
problem_here: Single-run keeps follow lucky seeds; agents inflate sample counts when allowed
mechanism: Screen with 1 run; if it clears the noise floor mark it promising; confirm on the fixed panel shared with the incumbent; n and margin are config the agent cannot change; repeats count toward budgets
evidence: https://primeintellect.ai/blog/measuring-autonomous-research (2026-08-15: 8 fixed seeds, mean must beat 3.27859 against a 3.28 target, earlier runs abused sample counts, same seed still moves on GPU; vendor-measured); https://github.com/KellerJordan/modded-nanogpt (p<0.01 rule, read 2026-11-11); https://elianaive.com/posts/another-typical-autoresearch-post/ (2026-07-31, single author, byte-identical submission swung 20%)
maturity: Standard in speedrun records; two ports repeat before a keep
cost: Each keep costs N extra runs; on a 5-minute task with N=3 that is 15 GPU-minutes per promising change
simpler_alternative: Single run with a large fixed threshold (cheaper, misses small real gains)
reason: Addresses the validity scenario (no kept result may depend on a lucky seed) with direct evidence
cheap_local_trial: Run one config 5 times on the char-level task, compute the spread, set the margin; check that an A/A candidate is never kept in 10 tries

candidate: A/A noise floor from repeated baselines (MAD-based, idea from pi-autoresearch v1.9.0)
what: Measure run-to-run spread of the unchanged baseline and express any delta as a multiple of it
problem_here: The kit has no measured noise level per task, so margins would be guesses
mechanism: n>=3 baseline runs at campaign start; robust spread (median absolute deviation); delta/MAD below 1 is noise, 1-2 uncertain, above 2 likely real; re-measure the incumbent on a schedule
evidence: https://github.com/davebcn87/pi-autoresearch (v1.9.0, 2026-10-06, README; accuracy of the score not published); https://github.com/prime-radiant-inc/superpowers-autoresearch (authors treat single-run deltas under about 20% as noise)
maturity: Shipped (advisory) in a tool with 8,230 stars
cost: 3+ baseline runs up front; MAD from 3 points is crude
reason: Cheap, stdlib-only, and needed to size the margin in the keep rule
cheap_local_trial: 3 baseline runs on the char-level task; print MAD and the implied margin

what: TypeScript extension giving the pi agent experiment tools, a results log and a dashboard
problem_here: none found (the kit targets three other agent products)
mechanism: Tools init_experiment, run_experiment, log_experiment; agent-written measure.sh; optional checks.sh; the agent decides keep or discard
evidence: https://github.com/davebcn87/pi-autoresearch (README and changelog read 2026-11-10)
cost: Node runtime, single host agent, runs with full user permissions, benchmark authored by the agent, confidence never gates
reason: Wrong host and agent-decides design; ideas worth taking: stop after many consecutive failures, deterministic state summary, revisit check, finalize into reviewable branches

candidate: Once-only final holdout behind a durable receipt, with hash-chained append-only ledger
what: Selection uses validation only; the test split is opened once per campaign after the choice is recorded
problem_here: Loop selection inflates validation scores; the kit guards final evaluation but has no receipt or tamper-evident ledger
mechanism: Write a receipt (commit, config hash, validation evidence) before the final run; refuse a second final run for the same campaign; each ledger line carries the hash of the previous line
evidence: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06607 (2026-11, abstract; Sharpe about 3 fell to 0.26 on single holdout use; author-measured); selection gaps: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40303 (6.83 points below oracle), https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05398 (up to 5.38 points)
maturity: One Nov 2026 paper plus classic practice
cost: Small: stdlib hashlib and JSONL; ledger verification fails if users hand-edit it
simpler_alternative: Existing guard on final evaluation without a receipt
reason: Makes kept results verifiable from saved artifacts, as the validity scenario requires
cheap_local_trial: Unit test: second final-eval request is refused; editing one ledger line fails verification

candidate: One fresh agent process per iteration with harness-owned research state
what: Each iteration starts a new headless agent given a short state summary built by code; nothing is carried in agent context
problem_here: Long sessions anchor on early ideas, decay after compaction and cannot be budgeted per step
mechanism: Controller writes incumbent, ledger tail, tried-ideas list and limits into a prompt; starts one bounded worker; reads its diff; discards the session
evidence: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07625 (2026-10-06, over 84% fewer tokens to match a strong baseline); https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20563 (2026-10-14, up to 39% over a single agent); https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07447 (2026-10-05); all author-measured, abstracts only; caution: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05108 finds persistent state helps efficiency but not final results
maturity: Three independent 2026 papers; one Codex port uses one worker per iteration
cost: Start-up tokens per iteration (re-reading the repo); summary quality limits progress
simpler_alternative: One long session with compaction (upstream default)
reason: Fits minimal-scaffold evidence, makes per-iteration limits and clean stops possible, and matches the newest equal-budget results
cheap_local_trial: Run 3 iterations as separate headless invocations on the char-level task and compare token use with one continued session

candidate: Parallel fresh-context forks in separate worktrees (fork-and-flush style)
what: Several fresh workers branch from the incumbent at once; the best result becomes the new incumbent
problem_here: none found on one GPU (runs would queue); relevant only with several GPUs or remote capacity
mechanism: K workers in their own worktrees, selection by the harness evaluator, all contexts flushed
evidence: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07447 (2026-10-05, +66.0% vs single run and +44.4% vs best-of-N at equal compute on 13 long tasks, author-measured); https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40303 found three parallel workers not significantly different on ML tasks
maturity: One paper plus one plugin implementation (2026-10)
cost: K times the tokens; GPU contention; worktree management on Windows
reason: Evidence is for long parallel tasks and conflicts with the ML-task result; no use on a single GPU

candidate: Ladder-style coarse feedback with a pre-set validation query budget
what: The agent learns only whether a run beat the best so far by a step, and the number of scored queries is fixed in advance
problem_here: Dozens of adaptive validation queries per night can overfit the validation split
mechanism: Harness returns improved or not improved (optionally a rounded value) only when the margin is cleared; K_max and T_max fixed in config
evidence: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.11045 (2026-06-09, NeurIPS 2026: one-bit feedback matched or beat score feedback on 8 tasks, 3 runs per condition, author-measured); bound O(log(kn)^(1/3)/n^(1/3)) restated in https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.02733 for https://arxiv.org/abs/1502.04585
cost: Less information for the agent; may slow search at small budgets (untested); trivial code
simpler_alternative: Scalar feedback with a hidden once-only test split
reason: Cheap flag with supporting evidence, but scalar feedback was already benign in the same study, so the default stays scalar
cheap_local_trial: Two short campaigns on the char-level task (scalar vs one-bit); compare final hidden-test score

candidate: Validation and test examples unreadable by the agent and by training code
what: The agent gets scores, never eval examples; eval data sits outside the worktree
problem_here: Overfitting in agent loops came from reading or training on validation samples, not from reusing scores
mechanism: Eval split stored outside the editable tree and loaded only by the evaluator process; guard denies reads; OS-level read denial where a sandbox exists
evidence: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.11045 (38 of 102 checkpoints exceeded a 10% gap when sample-level access was allowed; author-measured); https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.18064 (19-41 memorised eval rows per run; announcing a hidden test removed it)
maturity: Standard benchmark practice (hidden tests in 2026 agent benchmarks)
cost: On native Windows without a container this is advice-level (no OS sandbox); training code needs a train-only data path
simpler_alternative: Instruction not to read eval data (shown to fail)
reason: Strongest single predictor of invalid results in the evidence
cheap_local_trial: A scripted fake agent tries to open the eval file from training code; record what is blocked on Windows vs WSL2

candidate: Short-recipe reproduction check for kept gains
what: A fresh agent given a few-line description of the kept change and training data only must reproduce the gain
problem_here: Detects gains that depend on hidden leakage or unreported changes
mechanism: Write a recipe of at most 128 tokens per audited keep; a fresh worker reimplements it from the baseline; the harness compares scores
evidence: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.11045 (128-token reproducer flagged all 38 overfit checkpoints plus 6 of 64 others: 100% sensitivity, 91% specificity; 32-token recipes reproduced 38 of 41 honest gains; author-measured)
cost: One extra agent session plus training run per audited keep
simpler_alternative: Re-run the kept commit from a clean worktree on the seed panel
reason: Promising audit for end-of-campaign winners; too costly per keep
cheap_local_trial: Apply to one kept change on the char-level task

candidate: Evaluator self-test with null, no-op and tamper fixtures

mechanism: Fixtures: no-op change (must not be kept), edited evaluator (invalid), fake printed score (ignored), out-of-scope edit (stopped), constant-output model (sanity check fails)
evidence: https://rdi.berkeley.edu/blog/trustworthy-benchmarks-cont/ (2026-04: eight agent benchmarks exploitable to about 100%; checklist with null, random and tampering agents; university group)

reason: Cheap proof that the loop's gates work on this machine and agent
cheap_local_trial: Run the fixture suite with a stub trainer in under a minute

cost: False sense of safety if presented as a control
reason: The diff allowlist is a real control; the pattern scan is cheap audit help and must be labelled advisory
cheap_local_trial: Feed three known tamper diffs and three clean diffs through the scan
